resources.string: When a supported device is connected, the app requests USB access and connects to ADB. If the key is not trusted yet, confirm USB debugging on the connected device. Fastboot queries require a button press; flashing is unavailable.
Connect a device with a USB OTG cable, then refresh the list.
USB host mode is unavailable on this phone.
%1$s (config %2$d, interface %3$d): bulk IN/OUT found. Connection result appears below.
%1$s (config %2$d, interface %3$d): no usable bulk IN/OUT pair.
No ADB or Fastboot USB interface detected.
Could not inspect USB interfaces. Save a diagnostic ZIP.
Waiting for the first ADB reply…
ADB connects automatically after USB permission. If it failed or was cancelled, retry manually. No ADB commands will be run.
Preparing the key and exchanging ADB messages…
Key sent. Confirm USB debugging on the connected device (up to 2 minutes), or cancel waiting.
ADB replied CNXN: version %1$s, maxData %2$d. Connection established; session closed.
The first ADB reply was AUTH. This separate check does not sign the token, so it cannot tell whether the key is already trusted. Check the ADB connection result.
ADB requested TLS. This check does not negotiate TLS.
ADB exchange failed. Save a diagnostic ZIP.
Fastboot replied FAIL for %1$s: %2$s. USB exchange succeeded.
USB exchange failed for %1$s. Save a diagnostic ZIP.
USB access allowed. ADB and Fastboot diagnostic buttons appear for supported devices.
Android could not request access to this device.
After checking the connection, save a ZIP with app events, Android details and USB interface descriptors. ADB keys and tokens, device banners and serial numbers are not saved.
Diagnostic file saved. You can attach it to a message.
Could not save the diagnostic file. Choose a different folder and try again.
